dump_config.name: Dump configuration
dump_config.description: Export the full free@home Local API JSON configuration to the Home Assistant config folder.

host.name: Host
host.description: Optional SysAP host IP/hostname to limit the dump to a specific SysAP.

monitor.name: Monitor WebSocket frames
monitor.description: Record raw WebSocket JSON frames from the Local API into a JSONL file in the Home Assistant config folder.

set_datapoint.name: Set datapoint
set_datapoint.description: Write a raw datapoint value to the SysAP Local REST API (e.g. for virtual device feedback).

serialnumber.name: Serial number
serialnumber.description: Device serial number or virtual device serial (e.g. 6000A1B2C3D4).

datapoint_id.name: Datapoint ID
datapoint_id.description: Input or output datapoint identifier (e.g. idp0000 or odp0000).

value.name: Value
value.description: String value to write to the datapoint.

sysap_uuid.name: SysAP UUID
sysap_uuid.description: Optional SysAP UUID (defaults to primary SysAP UUID).

register_virtual_device.name: Register virtual device
register_virtual_device.description: Register or refresh a virtual/proxy device on the SysAP with optional automatic TTL heartbeat renewal.

native_id.name: Native ID
native_id.description: Unique identifier supplied by your automation for the virtual device.

ttl.name: TTL (seconds)
ttl.description: Time-to-live in seconds (0 = mark unresponsive, -1 = persistent, >0 = periodic keep-alive).

capabilities.name: Capabilities
capabilities.description: Optional capability list (for EnergyMeterv2 or MediaPlayer).

unregister_virtual_device.name: Unregister virtual device
unregister_virtual_device.description: Stop the TTL heartbeat and mark a persisted virtual device unresponsive (ttl=0) on the SysAP.

native_id.name: Native ID
native_id.description: Unique identifier of the virtual device to unregister.

trigger_proxy_device.name: Trigger proxy device action
trigger_proxy_device.description: Trigger an action (shortpress, longpress, release) on a free@home proxy device.

send_notification.name: Send SysAP notification
send_notification.description: Push a notification message to the free@home SysAP (displayed in the app/panels).

cover_force_position.name: Force cover position
cover_force_position.description: Force a cover into a specific position (open, closed, or none).

forced_position.name: Forced position
forced_position.description: Target forced state (open, closed, or none).

thermostat_temperature_correction.name: Set thermostat temperature correction
thermostat_temperature_correction.description: Change the temperature correction offset parameter of a thermostat.

temperature_correction.name: Temperature correction
temperature_correction.description: Signed temperature offset in degrees Celsius.

migrate_from_legacy.name: Migrate from legacy freeathome
migrate_from_legacy.description: Preview or migrate device names, areas, entity metadata, Assist exposure, and Recorder history from the legacy freeathome integration into freeathome_ng.

entry_id.name: Hub entry ID
entry_id.description: Optional config entry ID of the target free@home NG SysAP.

host.name: Host
host.description: Optional SysAP host IP/hostname to select the target free@home NG hub.

dry_run.name: Preview only (dry run)
dry_run.description: Inspect the exact migration plan without modifying entries, devices, or entities.

cutover.name: Cutover (remove legacy entry and preserve entity IDs / history)
cutover.description: Copy metadata only when off, or remove the legacy freeathome entry and rename matching entity IDs when enabled with dry_run=false.

serialnumbers.name: Serial numbers filter (optional)
serialnumbers.description: Optional comma- or newline-separated device serial numbers for selective preview or metadata sync.
